name: Stripe Managed Payments
line: Merchant of record service for eligible digital sales through Stripe.

free.text: No setup fees or monthly minimum; transaction fees apply

cells.countries: US, UK, Germany and other listed markets; India not listed
cells.payout: Usually 5–7 business days; first payout 7–14 days

fee.math: US sellers are supported, but Managed Payments pricing doesn't list a US card rate.
UK processing 1.5% + Managed Payments 3.5% = 5%, plus GBP 0.20 per successful payment.
German sellers are supported, but no German card rate is published in the Managed Payments pricing.
India isn't one of the supported seller locations. Its India marketing page doesn't confirm that sellers can sign up.
